item.title: Petros Kouloumis - Resonate Sessions
item.description: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lEVtY9v1PWU Song: MadhubalaAnother live production with a special arrangement of the song 'Mandoubala' by Cypriot musician and performer Petros Kouloumis. The elements of Folk and Traditional music, where he specializes, are prominent throughout the song, giving a unique approach to a timeless classic. Petros Kouloumis: Vocals/ArrangementNikos Angousis: ClarinetEvangelos Evangelou: GuitarEfthivoulos Theocharous: Piano Special Thanks to our sponsors: Kyriakides

item.title: Myriam West - Resonate Sessions
item.description: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NuPuact8SmM Song: I'm not asking for the moon “I'm not asking for the moon” is a song about the strength, the struggle, the love, the hope and the realities of having a child with special needs and/or medical conditions. Any parent who has seen their child struggle will resonate with the breathtaking song that Myriam West wrote

item.title: Gaya Yona - Resonate Sessions
item.description: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Eyryq2ZoPJY Song: Vertigo "Vertigo" tells the story of the dizzying realization of love for a longtime friend, a moment as disorienting as vertigo itself. Through simple yet evocative lyrics, Gaya explores the imagined world of 'what if,' where all the unsaid things and missed opportunities come to life. This song captures the essence of longing
